integrity: Two complete C++17 state-space traversals and their exact outputs are supplied. They agree on the labelled first-entry and eventual-period profile.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite census for the specified carousel orientation and synchronous rule only. The carousel recurrent states follow from centered majority, and the same-size Paley census is a comparison, not an originality claim. No universal transient bound or historical priority is asserted.
title: Exact majority basins and a sharp four-update entry bound in the 23-vertex carousel tournament
